answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond carved as a marble entry in a public ledger before it can claim rewards, with peers able to slash it on proven fraud. One honest agent crosses one river of verified work once, while a sybil farm must fund a bond for every copy, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds. A crystal-clear record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a puppet cluster back to one sponsor and freeze it at once, making mass fakery scale cost linearly while honest participation pays once.
